info.name: Equipment Packs
info.description: Equipment Packs from Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

element.name: Hunter's Kit
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Sometimes called a "vampire hunting kit," the Hunter's Kit contains the following items: 6 Candles, Crowbar, Holy Symbol, 2 vials of Holy Water, Backpack, Mirror, 4 Torches, and Wooden Stakes.
Note: Due to the app's limitations, this kit doesn't include Holy Symbol (can be selected under "Spellcasting Focus" category).

element.name: Class Equipment Pack (Kindred)
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: This pack contains items that are given to a character of Kindred Class, if you chose option A for Equipment.
You will receive following items by extracting contents of this pack:
Note: This pack doesn't include Leather Armor, Artisan's Tools of your choice (can be selected under "Tools" category) and 15 GP.
